name: Ringlet Fantasy
source:
Main character plays an RPG game and soon finds himself among game characters. Will he be able to defeat mysterious machines that attack human houses and return back to original world successfully?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-february-2008-switch-boku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公正在玩一款RPG，却很快发现自己来到了游戏角色之中。他能否击败袭击人类住宅的神秘机械，顺利返回原本的世界？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-february-2008-switch-boku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
